description.la: Quattuor oraciones a Deo Birgittae reuelatae: laudes Mariae, Christi, membrorum corporis Christi et Virginis.
description.en-US: The Four Prayers revealed by God to Bridget: praises of the Virgin Mary, of Christ, of the members of Christ's body and of the Virgin's. The Latin is the SSFS critical text; the English is the anonymous translation circulated by catholic-saints.net.
description.pt-BR: As Quatro Orações reveladas por Deus a Brígida: louvores à Virgem Maria, a Cristo e aos membros do corpo de Cristo e da Virgem.

sources.edition: Sancta Birgitta, Revelaciones / Opera minora, Samlingar utgivna av Svenska fornskriftsällskapet, Ser. 2, Latinska skrifter VII, ed. Sten Eklund (Stockholm, 1991).
sources.description: Word-file transcription distributed by Documenta Catholica Omnia (also circulated as the Riksarkivet CRB texts), book "XII". Cleaned by research/sourcing/_scripts/bridget_build.py: drop-cap braces and stray quotes removed, hyperlink artefacts removed, the edition's inline verse numbers dropped (paragraphs break at verse boundaries), chapter rubrics kept in italics under each heading.
sources.tierEvidence: Freely distributed online transcription of a medieval text.

sources.edition: The Prophecies and Revelations of Saint Bridget of Sweden, texts from www.Catholic-Saints.net (Jazzybee Verlag, 2013); translator not named.
sources.description: OCR of the ebook text, paragraphs rejoined across page breaks and line-end hyphens closed; each chapter keeps its rubric in italics.
